# Scrutate

> Universal instant code search and persistent code intelligence, in one Rust binary. Engine A searches any folder with no index; Engine B indexes a repository for ranked search by meaning or name, definitions, callers, references and the tests a git diff touches. A CLI, an MCP server for AI coding agents, a language server and Python bindings. No network use. MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Each link is the raw Markdown of a document in the repository, followed by the question it answers.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scrutate/scrutate/main/README.md): What does scrutate do, how do I start, and what was measured?
